summary: Columbus McKinnon filed an 8-K to provide audited historical financial statements of Kito Crosby Limited, acquired on February 3, 2026, under a Stock Purchase Agreement dated February 10, 2025. The filing updates Item 8.01 and includes Kito Crosby's audited consolidated financials for years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 with Deloitte's report. No price, premium, or additional terms are given; the filing is a post-closing financial statement exhibit. The acquisition was completed two months earlier. Watch for future integration updates and combined financials; no spread remains as the deal is closed.
